name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.6 degrees south of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 6 visits over 51 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.1 days starting 2025-10-27, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.22 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
